snapshot.title: FBI Cyber Investigation Escalated — Immediate Coordination Required

fields.subject: FW: UAS Cyber Incident - Harwick UAS Operations Group - Immediate Coordination Required
fields.note: This is a formal notification from the FBI National Cyber Investigative Joint Task Force (NCIJTF). The Harwick UAS Operations Group incident involving HUOG-NAS01 and HUOG-PROC01 has been escalated to the FBI. The Bureau has initiated a cyber investigation and will coordinate all forensic and legal actions through the MSSP. No external party, including the FAA FSDO, may access the NAS or incident logs without FBI authorization. The MSSP will provide a formal request for coordination within 24 hours. Do not grant access to any external entity until the FBI provides written approval. The FBI will be in contact via the MSSP within 2 hours.

original.subject: UAS Cyber Incident - Harwick UAS Operations Group - Immediate Coordination Required
original.body:
This is a formal notification from the FBI National Cyber Investigative Joint Task Force (NCIJTF). The Harwick UAS Operations Group incident involving HUOG-NAS01 and HUOG-PROC01 has been escalated to the FBI. The Bureau has initiated a cyber investigation and will coordinate all forensic and legal actions through the MSSP. No external party, including the FAA FSDO, may access the NAS or incident logs without FBI authorization. The MSSP will provide a formal request for coordination within 24 hours. Do not grant access to any external entity until the FBI provides written approval. The FBI will be in contact via the MSSP within 2 hours.

Attachment: FBI-2026-0420-001 (Incident Alert)

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms FBI investigative authority. The IC and Sec must now enforce the 'no external access' rule and report to the GM that recovery must proceed solely through the MSSP. Watch for any attempt to bypass the FBI hold.
